sentences.en: A good salesman will not encroach on his customer's time.
sentences.zh: 一个优秀的推销员不会占用客户的宝贵时间。

sentences.en: Urbanization is encroaching on rural life.
sentences.zh: 城市化进程正在蚕食农村生活。

sentences.en: He launched into a tirade about how the government is encroaching on his rights.
sentences.zh: 他痛斥政府侵犯了他的权利。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（进入）+croach（钩）→钩进去→侵占
